digest.lead: Claude Code gets a significant v2.1.162 update with enhanced session monitoring and improved tool handling for developers.
digest.summary: Anthropic also expanded its research into AI-enabled cyber threats and launched a new services partner hub for enterprise integrations.

stories.headline: Anthropic Publishes Research on AI-Enabled Cyber Threats
stories.summary: Anthropic released new research examining AI-enabled cyber threats through the MITRE ATT&CK framework [1]. The research appears to analyze how AI systems could be misused in cybersecurity attacks.
stories.impact: This research helps security professionals and policymakers understand emerging AI-powered threat vectors and develop appropriate defenses.

sources.title: AI Enabled Cyber Threats Mitre Attack

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Services Track Partner Hub
stories.summary: Anthropic unveiled a new Services Track Partner Hub, expanding its ecosystem of enterprise service providers [1]. The hub appears designed to connect businesses with certified partners for Claude implementation and support.
stories.impact: Enterprise customers now have better access to professional services for Claude deployment, potentially accelerating adoption in large organizations.

stories.headline: Claude Code v2.1.162 Enhances Session Monitoring and Tool Handling
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code update introduces several developer-focused improvements [1]. The `claude agents --json` command now includes a `waitingFor` field that shows what's blocking waiting sessions, while the tools system better handles explicit Grep/Glob requests on native builds with embedded search.
key_points: New `waitingFor` status in JSON output helps debug blocked agent sessions
Improved tool handling for Grep/Glob on native builds with embedded search
Slash command autocomplete now fills commands instead of immediately executing them
stories.impact: Daily Claude Code users will have better visibility into agent session states and more predictable command interactions, improving debugging workflows.

stories.headline: Claude Opus 4.8 Max Shows Unexpected Behavior with Empty Prompts
stories.summary: A user shared on social media that Claude Opus 4.8 Max responds to completely empty messages, sparking discussion about the model's prompt handling [1]. The behavior has generated interest in the developer community about how the model processes null inputs.
stories.impact: This unusual behavior could indicate changes in how the latest Claude model handles edge cases, relevant for developers building applications with Claude integration.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.8 Max responding to an empty message

stories.headline: Use `/reload-skills` to refresh skills without restarting
stories.summary: When you add or modify Claude Code skills, you can reload them instantly without losing your current session context. This saves time during skill development and testing workflows.
actionable_steps: Make changes to your skill files
Verify new or updated skills are available in the current session

stories.headline: Use visual mode in Claude Code for text selection and editing
stories.summary: Claude Code now supports vim-style visual mode (v) and visual-line mode (V) for selecting and manipulating text. This enables more efficient text editing workflows similar to vim editors.
actionable_steps: Press 'v' to enter visual mode for character-by-character selection
Press 'V' to enter visual-line mode for line-by-line selection
Use standard vim operators on your selected text

stories.headline: Enable PowerShell tool for Windows development workflows
stories.summary: Claude Code now includes an opt-in PowerShell tool that allows Windows users to execute PowerShell commands directly through Claude. This provides native Windows command-line access for system administration and development tasks.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.84 or later
Enable the PowerShell tool in your settings as a preview feature

stories.headline: Use @-mentions to give Claude Code precise file context
stories.summary: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, recommends using @-mentions to point Claude at specific files instead of letting it search. This dramatically reduces token usage and improves accuracy since Claude works with the exact files you intend rather than guessing from project structure.
actionable_steps: Type @ in Claude Code to see a file picker with fuzzy search
Select the specific files relevant to your task before writing your prompt
Combine multiple @-mentions for cross-file tasks like refactoring

stories.headline: Set CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 to eliminate screen flickering
stories.summary: This environment variable enables flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback in Claude Code v2.1.88+. It provides a smoother visual experience when Claude Code switches between screen modes during long coding sessions.
actionable_steps: Add 'export CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1' to your shell profile (.bashrc, .zshrc, etc.)
Restart your terminal or run 'source ~/.bashrc' to apply the change
Launch Claude Code to verify flicker-free rendering is active
